versions.changelog:
No file changes detected in this version.

- Version bump to 1.0.1 with no code or documentation changes.
- No new features, fixes, or updates included in this release.

- Initial release of llm-eval-harness.
- Systematically evaluate LLM outputs across multiple dimensions: accuracy, relevance, safety, consistency, and helpfulness.
- Run test suites and score responses using detailed rubrics.
- Compare model performance side-by-side with metrics for accuracy, speed, cost, and safety.
- Detect regressions after prompt or model updates and generate comprehensive evaluation reports.
- Supports automated evaluation methods including string matching, semantic similarity, code execution, and LLM-as-judge.
